dosing.evidence: On day 0, animals received an intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of either saline (vehicle-treated group) or a single dose of psilocybin (0.1, 0.32, 1.0, or 3.2 mg/kg; n = 8 per group).

handling.evidence: animals were acclimated to the procedure by measuring rectal temperature several times before the beginning of the study. To minimize stress, animals underwent indeed a 5-day habituation protocol before the beginning of the study.

group_housing.evidence: Rats were housed in two per cage at 22 ± 1°C under a 12 h light-dark cycle

day_night_flipped.evidence: Behavioral testing occurred in the morning during the light phase.

assays.assay_description: Rats placed in Open Field arena (45 × 45 × 45 cm) immediately after psilocybin/vehicle injection and recorded for 30 min. HTRs manually scored; locomotor activity (distance, velocity, mobility time, supported/unsupported rearing) tracked using EthoVision XT 15. Both HTR and locomotor measures collected in the same recording session.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of either saline or a single dose of psilocybin

setup_habituation.evidence: Immediately after the single injection of psilocybin or vehicle on day 0, rats were placed in an Open Field arena

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena (45 × 45 × 45 cm) and their behavior was recorded with a camera device for 30 min

food_restriction.evidence: Open Field arena with no food source mentioned during the 30 min recording

water_restriction.evidence: Open Field arena with no water source mentioned during the 30 min recording

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after the single injection of psilocybin or vehicle on day 0, rats were placed in an Open Field arena

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 per group; except for group 0.1, 0.32 and 3.2 mg/kg in which one outlier was detected in each of them. Note that given one error video file for group 0.1 mg/kg, the latter had only n = 6

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin produced an inverted U-shaped HTR dose-response peaking at 0.32 mg/kg (0.32 and 1.0 mg/kg significantly higher than VEH). Locomotor activity (mobility time, distance, velocity, rearing) was dose-dependently decreased, with strong motor suppression at 1.0 and 3.2 mg/kg.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin-induced HTR exhibited a characteristic inverted U-shaped dose-response curve, with a maximal response at 0.32 mg/kg... psilocybin dose-dependently decreased mobility time (F4,31 = 31.01, p < 0.0001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR, distance traveled, velocity, mobility time, supported rearing, unsupported rearing

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: a closer inspection of the time course of psilocybin-induced HTR revealed... an almost complete absence of new response after 5 min (Fig. 2B; cumulative HTR)... The time course of mobility time

B4_ethological.evidence: Parameters, such as supported/unsupported rearing were scored manually

B5_social.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena

B7_automated_classification.evidence: using EthoVision XT 15 tracking software; HTRs manually scored

E2_shelter.evidence: Open Field arena, no shelter described

E3_bedding.evidence: The arena was thoroughly cleaned with 70% ethanol and dried between test sessions

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena

D1_continuity.evidence: recorded with a camera device for 30 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: their behavior was recorded with a camera device for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Immediately after the single injection of psilocybin or vehicle on day 0

assays.assay_description: Rectal probe inserted 2 cm; temperature measured at -30 min and 0 min (baseline) and every 30 min for 120 min post-injection. Measures thermoregulatory side effect (physiological), but included here as candidates flagged it; note this is a physiological not behavioural readout.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of either saline or a single dose of psilocybin

setup_habituation.evidence: animals underwent indeed a 5-day habituation protocol before the beginning of the study

setup_restrain.evidence: A probe was inserted 2 cm into the rectum

time_to_assay.evidence: Rectal temperature was measured 30 min before the administration... and then every 30 min post-administration for 120 min

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin dose-dependently decreased rectal temperature; 1.0 and 3.2 mg/kg significantly produced hypothermia. Max temp drop: -0.93°C at 30 min (1.0 mg/kg); -1.51°C at 60 min (3.2 mg/kg).
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin dose-dependently decreased rats' body temperature (F4,35 = 23.37, p < 0.0001).

D1_continuity.evidence: Rectal temperature was measured 30 min before... every 30 min post-administration for 120 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: steady temperature readout was obtained within 10 s

D4_baseline.evidence: Rectal temperature was measured 30 min before the administration of psilocybin or vehicle (first baseline), immediately before the injection (0 min, second baseline)

assays.assay_description: Glass cylindrical tank (48 × 24 cm) with 30 cm water at 24°C. 15-min pre-test followed 24 h later by 5-min test. Performed three times: day 1 (FST 1), day 21 (FST 2), day 42 (FST 3) post-treatment. Behaviors scored manually: immobility, swimming, climbing, diving.

setup_habituation.evidence: pre-test is part of the FST protocol itself, not separate apparatus habituation

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed into a glass cylindrical tank... The water depth was such that the rats could not support themselves with their hind paws

water_restriction.evidence: no drinking water in FST cylinder

time_to_assay.evidence: FST 1 1 day after, FST 2 21 days after, FST 3 42 days post-treatment

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 per group; except for group VEH, 0.32, 1.0 and 3.2 mg/kg in which one outlier was detected in each of them

outcomes.summary: 0.32 mg/kg psilocybin produced rapid (24 h) and sustained (up to 42 days) antidepressant-like effects: reduced immobility and increased climbing across FST 1, FST 2, and FST 3 with inverted U-shape dose response. No effect on swimming. 1.0 mg/kg increased climbing only at FST 3.
outcomes.statistics: FST 1 immobility H=19.08, p<0.0001; climbing F4,31=6.57, p<0.001. FST 2 immobility H=19.53, p<0.001; climbing H=17.95, p<0.01. FST 3 immobility F4,31=14.96, p<0.0001; climbing F4,31=15.52, p<0.0001.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin produced rapid antidepressant-like effects, shown by a U-shaped dose-response curve in immobility... and an inverted U-shaped dose-response curve in climbing behavior, both peaking at 0.32 mg/kg

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: total time per behavior over 5 min reported

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility is not an ethological behaviour per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored manually by an experimenter blind to the study

D1_continuity.evidence: The test and its pre-test session were performed three times: on day 1 (FST 1)... day 21 (FST 2)... day 42 (FST 3)

D2_session_duration.evidence: During the pre-test phase... After a 15-minute swim

D3_recording_days.evidence: Pre-tests on days 0, 20, 41 and tests on days 1, 21, 42 = 6 recording days; but only tests scored — at minimum 3 test days plus 3 pre-test days

D4_baseline.evidence: pre-test sessions are part of FST procedure not pre-drug baseline (FST 1 pre-test was 4 h after psilocybin)

D5_followup.evidence: FST 2 21 days after, FST 3 42 days post-treatment

assays.raw_total_note: FST has 6 distinct days where behavior was recorded (3 pre-tests + 3 tests)

assays.assay_description: Two-bottle choice paradigm in home cage. Rats single-housed during testing. 1% sucrose vs water bottles overnight on day 6 and day 7 post-treatment with bottle position switched. Sucrose preference (%) and total liquid consumption measured.

setup_habituation.evidence: From day 3 to day 5, rats were acclimated to the presence of two water bottles in their home cage for 48 h... an additional 24-hour acclimation

time_to_assay.evidence: The Sucrose Preference Test (SPT) was performed 6 and 7 days post-psilocybin administration

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 per group; except for group 0.1, 0.32, 1.0 and 3.2 mg/kg in which one outlier was detected in each of them

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin produced inverted U-shaped dose-response in sucrose preference; 0.32 mg/kg significantly increased preference vs vehicle. No effect on total liquid consumption.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin produced an inverted U-shaped dose-response curve in sucrose preference, peaking at 0.32 mg/kg (F4,31 = 6.58, p < 0.001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: sucrose preference index and total liquid consumption

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The preference indexes calculated for each night were averaged

E1_environment_type.evidence: rats were single-housed... and presented with two regular bottles

E3_bedding.evidence: home cage with standard bedding implied

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were single-housed (for the duration of this task)

E8_food_water.evidence: presented with 2 bottles, one containing a 1% sucrose solution, and the other containing fresh water

D1_continuity.evidence: test day one on day 6... The procedure was repeated the following day (test day two on day 7)

D2_session_duration.evidence: 2 h before the onset of the dark cycle, water bottles were replaced... amount consumed during each night was measured (overnight ~12 h consumption period, but data collected as endpoint volume)

D6_circadian.evidence: consumed during each night (overnight measurement spans dark phase ≥6 h)

assays.assay_description: Dyadic free interaction. Two unfamiliar same-treatment rats placed simultaneously in arena (85 × 85 × 40 cm) in dimly lit room and recorded for 10 min on day 14 post-treatment. Investigative sniffing, anogenital sniffing, following, climbing over/under scored (duration and episodes) via EthoVision XT 15.

setup_habituation.evidence: 13 days after psilocybin or saline injection, animals were familiarized with an arena... allowed to explore freely for 30 min

setup_restrain.evidence: They were placed simultaneously in the arena

food_restriction.evidence: no food in arena during 10-min test

water_restriction.evidence: no water in arena during 10-min test

time_to_assay.evidence: The Social Interaction Test (SIT) was conducted 14 days post-psilocybin administration

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 per group; except for group 3.2 mg/kg in which one outlier was detected

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin produced inverted U-shaped dose-response in social interaction time, peaking at 0.32 mg/kg, which significantly increased social interaction vs vehicle. Other doses did not differ from control.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin produced an inverted U-shaped dose-response curve in total time spent in social interaction, peaking at 0.32 mg/kg (F4,34 = 7.09, p < 0.001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: investigative sniffing, anogenital sniffing, following, climbing over or under; duration and episodes

B4_ethological.evidence: investigative sniffing, anogenital sniffing, following, climbing over or under

B5_social.evidence: animals were tested in pairs... They were placed simultaneously in the arena

B7_automated_classification.evidence: An experimenter blind to the study analyzed the videos offline using Ethovision XT 15 (tracking software, not classifier)

E1_environment_type.evidence: arena made of black, rigid PVC foam (85 × 85 × 40 cm)

E3_bedding.evidence: PVC foam arena, no bedding mentioned

D1_continuity.evidence: recorded by a video camera for 10 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: recorded by a video camera for 10 min

judge_notes: Merged candidate qwen's separate 'Open Field' assay (treating HTR and locomotion as one) with candidate glm's split HTR and Open Field locomotion entries — these are the same recording session in the same apparatus, so I followed the rubric's 'same apparatus, same session' rule and consolidated into one assay capturing both HTR and locomotor measures.

Included Rectal Temperature as a separate entry since both candidates scored it; flagged as physiological rather than behavioural but retained for consistency with candidates and because it occurs in a measurement session with manual readout.
FST D3 set to 8-14 because 3 test days + 3 pre-test days = 6 recording days; conservatively scored as 2-7 (1 point) — corrected the FST raw_total accordingly.
Housing handling = yes based on explicit 5-day rectal-temperature handling protocol described in methods.
